test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following forts, India's nomination for the UNESCO World Heritage List for 2024-25, was the site of the coronation of Shivaji Maharaj?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Raigad Fort**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raigad Fort** is located in the **Raigad district of Maharashtra**.
 
• This fort is **historically significant** as it was the **site of the coronation of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj**, the founder of the Maratha Empire, in **1674**.
 
• The fort is situated at an altitude of **2,700 feet** above sea level, offering a strategic vantage point.
 
• Raigad Fort was originally known as **Rairi** and was renamed by Shivaji Maharaj.
 
• The fort is known for its **impressive architecture** and includes features such as the **Queen's quarters, public Durbar, watchtowers, and several gateways**.
 
• It played a crucial role in the history of the Maratha Empire and is considered a **symbol of Maratha pride and heritage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karnala Fort**__

 __
 
• **Karnala Fort** is located in the **Raigad district of Maharashtra**.
 
• This fort is also known as the **Funnel Hill** and is a popular trekking destination.
 
• Karnala Fort is situated within the **Karnala Bird Sanctuary** and offers a habitat for various bird species.
 
 
 
• **Korigad Fort**__
 __
 
• **Korigad Fort** is situated near **Lonavala in Maharashtra**.
 
• The fort is known for its **scenic views** and has a **large plateau** with two lakes at the top.
 
• Korigad Fort was incorporated into the kingdom of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in **1657**.
 
 
 
• **Mangi-Tungi Fort**__
 
 
• **Mangi-Tungi** is a prominent twin-pinnacle peak located in the **Nashik district of Maharashtra**.
 
• This site is a significant **Jain pilgrimage destination** and is known for its **ancient temples and sculptures**.
 
• The fort is situated at an elevation of **4,343 feet** above sea level.
